drivers.text: Revenue grew 21% YoY (about 10% sequentially excluding $201 million of Q2 promote income), which management ties to record leasing and strong demand for connectivity-rich environments.
Record bookings and backlog: weighted-average lag between signing and commencement was 17 months, so the $2.5 billion backlog is future revenue not yet in results.
Renewal rental rates rose 11.8% on a cash basis and 17.0% on a GAAP basis in Q3.

Development capex outlook (net of partner contributions) is $4.25 to $4.75 billion, raised from $3.25 to $3.75 billion in February; new land secured in Indianapolis, Chicago and Charlotte for large-scale campuses.
